summary: T13 fully implements the saved plan. All four acceptance criteria are met with the planned test surface, verified against the live workspace (git diff + file contents) and the recorded validation evidence. (AC4) pyproject.toml's sdist include list adds exactly the three planned installer/release entries (/packaging/install.sh, /scripts/generate_install_manifest.py, /RELEASING.md) while the wheel force-include payload and compose .env exclusion are unchanged. (AC1) tests/unit/cli/test_package_build_contents.py asserts wheel/sdist contents, the five _is_bootstrap_asset_root markers, every control-plane Dockerfile COPY input, METADATA Name/Version, the awf entry point, .env exclusion, and the version-drift guard; test_clean_install_smoke.py runs --help for awf/setup/start/init/mcp serve from an extracted wheel outside the checkout (asserting awf.__file__ resolves under the wheel) plus a best-effort venv lane. (AC2) test_bootstrap_packaged_assets.py resolves a real extracted wheel as the packaged bootstrap root (compose_env_file is None, _bootstrap_environment_file == Path('.env')) and test_start_commands.py covers packaged-asset selection when no source checkout is configured. (AC3) test_host_setup_source_assets.py pins that stale source metadata fails with SOURCE_CHECKOUT_ASSETS_STALE and fallback_used=False even when a valid packaged root is available, matched by the start-level no-mask behavior. Recorded focused validation (plans/T13_PACKAGE_ASSETS_VALIDATION.md): ruff check src/awf tests passed, mypy src/awf clean (294 files), pytest 160 passed for the focused selection, 112 passed for tests/unit/installer, 647 passed for tests/unit/cli + bootstrap_parts (no regressions), and uv build produced wheel+sdist with installer metadata present and compose .env excluded. The evidence is fresh (it ships in HEAD commit 2833fc5d on a clean working tree). Plan/validation docs exist; non-goals (T14/T15/T16 and container-internal worker/readiness resolution) are correctly deferred; the change is purely additive with no new src/awf code, so the 99% coverage gate is unaffected.
